title: Private Asset Management Inc. Buys 19,873 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Private Asset Management Inc. raised its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 20.1% in the second quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The fund owned 118,965 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 19,873 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 3.1% of Private Asset Management Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 4th biggest holding. Private Asset Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $19,961,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
A number of other hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the business. Dorsey Wright & Associates boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 9.2% in the 2nd quarter. Dorsey Wright & Associates now owns 3,205 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $593,000 after buying an additional 270 shares during the last quarter. Marcus Capital LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 6.8% in the first quarter. Marcus Capital LLC now owns 4,342 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $729,000 after purchasing an additional 275 shares during the last quarter. Canandaigua National Bank & Trust Co. lifted its stake in Apple by 0.5% in the first quarter. Canandaigua National Bank & Trust Co. now owns 51,711 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,676,000 after purchasing an additional 280 shares during the last quarter. TLP Group LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 25.3% in the first quarter. TLP Group LLC now owns 1,385 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $232,000 after purchasing an additional 280 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Winthrop Partners WNY LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 3.6% in the first quarter. Winthrop Partners WNY LLC now owns 8,222 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,398,000 after purchasing an additional 282 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.54% of the company’s stock.
